articles.title: Bio-Mech Skin
articles.summary: Dark blue-grey alien hide covered in raised interlocking worm-like tubes and vein ridges, satin sheen. Reads as dark teal with a pale blue topo-map or vein web; the fine grain disappears and it looks like glowing blue vein lines on dark metal.
articles.what: Interlocking domain-warped chitin tubes and pulsing veins over a fine pore grain — a living bio-mechanical alien hide in teal-and-violet, no two regions alike. Up close: Wavy pale-blue contour lines, 3-6 px thick with a light edge, closing into nested loops like a topographic map or fingerprint, on a dark teal-slate ground that carries a very fine worm-like pore grain. Small light-blue blobs sit on some loops; the loops are 30-120 px across. From a distance: Reads as dark teal with a pale blue topo-map or vein web; the fine grain disappears and it looks like glowing blue vein lines on dark metal. Measured spec (average): metal 240, roughness 67, coat 252. Shine: satin. Metal: full. It brings its own colours.
when: Best on: body, hero panel, sides.
Fits: gt / sports car, open wheel, show car.

None or a thin silver stripe: it is already busy

Not wood or leather despite the tags
